priya.k: Heads up — DSAR received for user 9a7b. Request: full deletion (records, embeddings, cached prompts). They explicitly asked 'remove from backups too'. Thoughts on KMS handling?

matt.b: If backups exist encrypted under current KMS key, simply deleting rows isn't enough. Options: rotate key + mark old key for scheduled deletion or create a forensic-preserve retention exception if theres an active incident.

eva.s: Quick note: we have a pending vuln triage (VULN-2099) that flagged a short-lived IAM policy grant to a third-party last month. Need to confirm whether that grant touched the embedding bucket or snapshot objects before proceeding.

priya.k: Legal — any holds?

legal-ops: No open holds on this user according to ticket PRIV-2210. Identity verified. If we find evidence of the IAM exposure affecting their objects, we must notify requester and consider a retention exception for forensics.

sam.o: Technical constraints: vector-store snapshots are retained for 60 days. We keep daily s3 snapshots with kms key arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/redwood-embeddings. Rotating the key alone won't immediately remove ciphertext from old snapshots — we need to delete objects.

jenny.p: RBAC: Who's allowed to run the delete job? We should limit to a short-lived service account (svc:privacy-runner) and require a two-person approval in formal audit UI. Also record the manifest hash and the approver ids in the audit entry.

matt.b: Proposed flow: 1) Pause any reindexing jobs for the user 2) Build manifest of affected object keys + vector ids 3) Legal approves and signs off in workflow 4) Run delete under svc:privacy-runner with transient creds 5) Rotate key and disable old key if no further exposure concerns 6) Purge snapshots for those object keys 7) Emit audit events to sec-audit stream.

eva.s: I'm running log correlation now. Found an assume-role event on 2026-02-14T03:04:12Z by external-sync@partner that had ReadObject on the embeddings bucket for 16 minutes. Correlating with access logs to see which objects were touched.

priya.k: If external actor read those objects, we need to escalate to incident response and open a retention-exception request (privacy-exceptions) — legal says we must notify the user about the exposure and estimated timeline. That may delay deletion past 30 days but must be documented.

legal-ops: Confirming: we can still prepare the manifest and the deletion plan, but we will not execute until IR confirms containment findings. If IR says no exposure to this user's objects, proceed.

sam.o: Implementation detail: delete job will call internal endpoint `POST /internal/privacy/erase` with body: user_id, manifest_id, approvers[]. Endpoint requires JWT from svc:privacy-runner and ephemeral mfa code. We'll add server-side checks for `privacy:erase` role.

matt.b: Audit entries should include: manifest_sha256, approver_uids, job_run_id, kms_key_before, kms_key_after, snapshot_ids_deleted. Keep logs immutable for compliance — write to sec-audit with WORM retention.

devsec-bot: VULN-2099 triage assigned to eva.s and matt.b; IR lead: jenny.p. If IR finds confirmed access, move to incident response and open PRIV-EX-301 (retention exception).

eva.s: IR update: correlated s3 access with object prefixes for user 9a7b — two objects were accessed but not all vectors. Access window short, no exfil logs found. IR recommends proceeding with planned erasure and documenting findings.

priya.k: Legal approves proceeding (approvers: priya.k + legal-ops). Please ensure we do NOT destroy old key; rotate and disable it, and retain its rotation audit for 1 year.

jenny.p: I'll grant svc:privacy-runner a time-bound role for this job and record the grant in RBAC audit. Two-person approval logged in UI.

sam.o: Kicking off job now under run id erase-20260321-77. Manifest id m-5589 created. Deletions: 19 vector rows, 4 postgres rows, 6 s3 snapshots removed. KMS rotation: new key redwood-embeddings-v2 created; old key disabled.

devsec-bot: Audit recorded: event_id e8c7-0a12. privacy.erase run erase-20260321-77 by svc:privacy-runner.

priya.k: Ticket updated PRIV-2210: erasure executed, manifest m-5589, KMS rotated (old key disabled), no retention exception needed. Notifying user with audit token and summary of actions. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
